topics.title: Health: more than not falling sick

concepts.learning_objective: State the WHO definition of health as complete physical, mental and social well-being.
Explain how habits and surroundings affect a person's physical, mental and social well-being.

topics.title: Staying healthy: lifestyle and a clean environment

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish healthy habits from unhealthy habits in daily life.
Explain how clean surroundings, clean air and water, and good relationships support health.

topics.title: Knowing we are unwell: signs and symptoms

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish a symptom (what we feel) from a sign (what can be seen or measured).
Identify pathogens such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, worms and protozoa as disease-causing organisms.
Classify diseases as communicable or non-communicable based on cause and spread.

topics.title: Spread and prevention of communicable diseases

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how communicable diseases spread through air, contact, food and water, and vectors.
Choose suitable preventive measures for diseases listed in Table 3.1.
Explain deficiency diseases and chronic diseases as types of non-communicable diseases.
Relate the causes, symptoms and prevention of lifestyle diseases such as diabetes and obesity.
Explain how vaccines train the immune system and why they are preventive, not curative.
Describe Jenner's smallpox vaccine and the traditional Indian practice of variolation.

topics.title: Treatment of diseases and antibiotic resistance

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that antibiotics act only against bacteria and recall the discovery of penicillin.
Explain how antibiotic resistance develops and how wise use of antibiotics prevents it.
